description: Na₃VO₄ is beta beryllia-derived structured and crystallizes in the tetragonal I̅42m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form distorted NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra and corners with eight equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.33 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra and corners with eight NaO₄ tetrahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.26 Å. V is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with twelve NaO₄ tetrahedra. All V-O bond lengths are 1.73 Å. O is bonded to three Na and one V atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃V tetrahedra.
